text: Annual leave policy. Full-time employees receive 14 days annual leave per calendar year.
answer: Employees receive 14 days annual leave per calendar year.

text: Travel claims approval. Travel claims must be reviewed and approved by the employee's direct manager before reimbursement.
answer: Travel claims are approved by the direct manager.

text: Expense submission deadline. Employees must submit expense claims within 30 days of incurring the expense.
answer: Expense submissions are due within 30 days of incurring the expense.

text: Meal reimbursement limits. The maximum meal reimbursement is 50 dollars per day.
answer: The maximum meal reimbursement is 50 dollars per day.

text: IT helpdesk contact. The internal IT helpdesk contact number is extension 4357.
answer: The IT helpdesk contact number is extension 4357.
